summary: The hierarchy and unit corrections themselves now look right in the edited scientific tables, and I did not find a surviving `K^{↔} ≥ E_R` / `E_R`-as-lower-bound regression in the Round 4 material. Review still fails because the consistency sweep is incomplete: a core hierarchy memo still contains explicit `E_R = K_D` / `K_D` terminology, and several current summary sections still label the AD degradable formula or the unknown two-way key quantity as `K_D` instead of `Q` / `K^{↔}`. There is also one stale historical `六态接近闭合` line plus a legacy alias test name.

issues.description: This file still uses `K_D` as the operative quantity in the dephasing section and explicitly states `E_R = K_D`. That leaves one of the banned formulas in a primary hierarchy memo even though the title was corrected to `Q ≤ K^{↔} ≤ E_R = E_R^PPT ≤ log_neg`.
issues.suggestion: Rename the dephasing table/prose to `K^{↔}` throughout and restate the result as `E_R^PPT = E_R = K^{↔}` for dephasing. Sweep the footer in the same file as well.

issues.description: Current summary/conclusion prose still refers to the degradable AD formula and the unknown two-way key quantity as `K_D`. `PHASE1_REPORT` still says `AD K_D analytic` and `AD γ>1/2 K_D`, and `log_neg_msEB_application` still says `真 K_D` in its main conclusions. These are live narrative sections, so the requested `Q` / `K^{↔}` terminology cleanup is not complete.
issues.suggestion: Rename these to `AD Q analytic`, `AD γ>1/2 K^{↔}`, and `true K^{↔}` / `two-way key capacity` respectively.

issues.description: A few supporting references still echo the withdrawn wording: `upper_bound_report` keeps `AD γ > 1/2 K_D`, `AD K_D = Q`, and a six-state `接近闭合` commit summary, while the alias coverage test is still named `test_K_D_amplitude_damping_degradable`. These are lower impact, but they will keep failing grep-based consistency checks.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite the report's open-item/changelog text to use `Q` / `K^{↔}` and describe the six-state claim as withdrawn, then rename the alias test to make the deprecation explicit.

round_recommendation: Do one final terminology sweep over the touched docs/tests for `K_D`, `K_D_amplitude_damping_degradable`, and stale `接近闭合` wording, then rerun the same grep checks. The underlying hierarchy/unit fixes look ready after that.
